name: @aexhq/repository
description: Repository for the aex SDK, CLI, contracts, user tests, and docs.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @aexhq/contracts build && bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk build
scripts.lint: bun run brand:check && bun run openapi:check && bun run openapi:types:check && bun run --filter @aexhq/contracts build && bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json && bun run --workspaces --if-present --parallel lint && bun run contracts:boundary:check && bun run lint:tests
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @aexhq/contracts build && bun run --filter @aexhq/contracts typecheck && bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk typecheck && bun run --filter @aexhq/cli typecheck && bun run --filter @aexhq/docs typecheck && bun run --filter @aexhq/user-tests typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test:unit: bun run build && bun run --workspaces --if-present test:unit && bun run test:validate
scripts.pack:sdk: bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk build && bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk pack:dry-run && bun run contracts:boundary:check
